caption:
Day 6 of The Gravel Expedition brings us 59.2 km north along the Guanacaste surf coast. We ride from Nosara past San Juanillo, Marbella, and Playa Negra, finishing at the south end of Tamarindo Bay.

782 metres of climbing remain, but the hardest days are behind you. This is a day for the coast — fast gravel, surf breaks, and the final stretch toward Hotel Capitán Suizo.

We stay here for 2 nights before a final ride to the shell beaches of Playa Conchal. We finish on the Pacific with the people who started as strangers and end as the only ones who understand what just happened.

The Gravel Expedition. Next departures 23 to 31 January 2027 and 3 to 11 July 2027. Details in the bio.
